services.name: Fishing Boats
services.desc: Known for the trophy-sized smallmouth bass stocked in its waters, Jordanelle Reservoir opened for public fishing in 1995. Located conveniently between Park City and Heber City, local anglers can wet their first fly after just a short drive. The reservoir is also home to brown trout, rainbow trout, walleye, and yellow perch. These are basic, open aluminum boats - they get you out on the water and that's it.
